tools.name: zoomdocs_login
tools.description: Use this only when another Zoom Docs tool says authentication is required. It opens or focuses the local Zoom Docs browser window so the user can log in, and that browser profile is reused across future sessions until Zoom expires it.

tools.name: zoomdocs_status
tools.description: Check whether the local Zoom Docs browser session is authenticated. Use this after zoomdocs_login or when diagnosing auth issues.

tools.name: zoomdocs_search
tools.description: Use this first when the user mentions a Zoom Doc by name, topic, or content but does not provide an exact file ID or URL. Runs native Zoom Docs full-text search across the account (titles and body content as indexed by Zoom) and returns ranked results so the agent can resolve the right doc before reading or writing.

query.description: Natural-language query to search for. Matches titles and indexed body content.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

file_types.description: Restrict results by Zoom file type. Defaults to ["database","classicDoc","doc","page"] which matches the Zoom Docs UI behavior.

include_deleted.description: Include docs that have been moved to trash. Defaults to false.

tools.name: zoomdocs_list
tools.description: List Zoom Docs files/folders under root or a specific folder. Use this when folder structure matters more than fuzzy title search.

parent_id.description: Folder ID or Zoom Docs folder URL. Defaults to my-docs.

tools.name: zoomdocs_get_metadata
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a Zoom Docs file by ID or URL. Use this when the user already gave an exact file identifier or URL.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

tools.name: zoomdocs_get_edit_outline
tools.description: Read a Zoom Doc structure as agent-friendly editable refs. Use this before zoomdocs_edit_doc when exact text is hard to target; then pass target.by = "ref" with one of the returned refs.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

tools.name: zoomdocs_get_access_info
tools.description: Read sharing, collaborator, link-access, publish-status, and pending permission-request state for a Zoom Doc. This is read-only and should be used before changing permissions.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

tools.name: zoomdocs_get_comments
tools.description: Read open or resolved comments from a Zoom Doc. This is read-only. It extracts inline comment thread refs from the doc content and reads thread/comment data without mutating the document.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

thread_status.description: Which comment threads to read. Defaults to open.

thread_id.description: Optional exact thread ID to return. Useful after mutations or when a doc has many comments.

tools.name: zoomdocs_add_doc_comment
tools.description: Add a whole-doc comment to a Zoom Doc, then read comments back to verify. Supports plain text, explicit mention content parts, and local file attachments. This does not create inline/anchored comments or permission changes.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

text.description: Plain-text comment body. Required unless content_parts is provided.

content_parts.description: Rich comment content parts. Use explicit mention parts instead of free-form @ lookup.

user_id.description: Explicit Zoom user ID to mention. Resolve with zoomdocs_search_share_targets first.

name.description: Display name for the mention payload.

notify.description: Whether Zoom should notify the mentioned user. Defaults to true.

attachments.description: Local files to upload and attach to the comment.

path.description: Local path to upload as a Zoom Docs comment attachment.

name.description: Attachment display name. Defaults to local basename.

content_type.description: MIME type. Inferred from extension when omitted.

tools.name: zoomdocs_reply_to_comment
tools.description: Add a plain-text reply to an existing Zoom Docs comment, then read comments back to verify. Requires explicit file_id, thread_id, and parent_comment_id from zoomdocs_get_comments. Does not support mentions or attachments in replies yet.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

parent_comment_id.description: Existing comment ID to reply to, from zoomdocs_get_comments.

thread_status.description: Status bucket where the parent comment currently lives. Defaults to open.

tools.name: zoomdocs_resolve_comment_thread
tools.description: Resolve an existing Zoom Docs comment thread, then read the resolved comments bucket back to verify. Requires explicit file_id and thread_id from zoomdocs_get_comments.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

tools.name: zoomdocs_reopen_comment_thread
tools.description: Reopen a resolved Zoom Docs comment thread, then read the open comments bucket back to verify. Requires explicit file_id and thread_id from zoomdocs_get_comments. This was replay-verified on a disposable test doc.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

thread_id.description: Resolved comment thread ID from zoomdocs_get_comments.

tools.name: zoomdocs_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a non-root Zoom Docs comment/reply, then read comments back to verify it is gone. Requires explicit file_id, thread_id, and comment_id from zoomdocs_get_comments. Root comment / whole-thread deletion is intentionally refused until separately replay-verified.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

comment_id.description: Non-root comment/reply ID to delete, from zoomdocs_get_comments.

thread_status.description: Status bucket where the comment currently lives. Defaults to open.

tools.name: zoomdocs_add_inline_comment
tools.description: Add an inline/anchored comment to a unique selected substring in one simple editable block, then read comments back to verify. Prefer target.by = ref from zoomdocs_get_edit_outline. Fails closed for ambiguous text or existing inline-rich blocks; if marker insertion fails after thread creation, it resolves the orphan thread before returning ok:false.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

value.description: Exact visible block text containing selected_text. No fuzzy matching is applied.

within_heading.description: Optional exact heading text used only to disambiguate repeated visible text.

value.description: Exact visible heading text containing selected_text.
Editable ref returned by zoomdocs_get_edit_outline, for example h2:plan/p1.

target.description: High-level locator for the block to anchor the inline comment in. Prefer ref; do not pass block IDs.

selected_text.description: Exact visible substring to anchor the comment to. Must occur exactly once in the matched block.

text.description: Plain-text comment body. Mentions and attachments are not supported for inline comments yet.

tools.name: zoomdocs_add_comment_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to an existing Zoom Docs comment, then read comments back to verify. Requires explicit file_id, thread_id, and comment_id from zoomdocs_get_comments.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

reaction.description: Emoji reaction to add, for example 💙.

thread_status.description: Status bucket to read back for verification. Defaults to open.

tools.name: zoomdocs_search_share_targets
tools.description: Search Zoom users and channels that can be selected in the Share dialog. This is read-only. Use it to resolve a user_id before inviting a specific collaborator.

query.description: Name or email fragment to search for in Zoom contacts/channels.

tools.name: zoomdocs_set_link_access
tools.description: Set account-level or anyone-with-link access for a specific Zoom Doc, then read permissions back to verify. Use zoomdocs_get_access_info first. Requires an explicit file_id/URL and only changes link/account access; it does not invite collaborators, remove collaborators, transfer ownership, or publish the doc.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL. Do not use fuzzy search inside this mutating tool.

scope.description: Which access scope to change: Zoom account/org access or anyone-with-link access.

role.description: Access role to set for the selected scope. Use noAccess to disable link access.

tools.name: zoomdocs_add_user_collaborator
tools.description: Invite a specific Zoom user collaborator to a doc, then read permissions back to verify. Requires an explicit file_id and user_id from zoomdocs_search_share_targets. This only adds user collaborators; it does not change org/link access, invite channels, invite external emails, transfer ownership, or publish the doc.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

send_email.description: Whether Zoom should send email notification. Defaults to false.

send_chat_message.description: Whether Zoom should send chat notification. Defaults to false.

tools.name: zoomdocs_set_user_collaborator_role
tools.description: Change the role of an existing Zoom user collaborator on a doc, then read permissions back to verify. Requires an explicit file_id and user_id. This only changes user collaborator roles; it does not change org/link access, invite channels, invite external emails, transfer ownership, or publish the doc.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

user_id.description: Zoom user ID whose collaborator role should change.

is_email_invitee.description: Whether the target is an email invitee. Defaults to false for normal Zoom users.

tools.name: zoomdocs_remove_user_collaborator
tools.description: Remove a specific Zoom user collaborator from a doc, then read permissions back to verify. Requires an explicit file_id and user_id. This only removes user collaborators; it does not change org/link access, remove channels, transfer ownership, or publish the doc.

file_id.description: Exact Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

user_id.description: Zoom user ID to remove from collaborators.

is_email_invitee.description: Whether the target is an email invitee. Defaults to false for normal Zoom users.

tools.name: zoomdocs_read
tools.description: Read a specific Zoom Doc and return Markdown. Use this when the user asks to summarize, quote, inspect, compare, or extract content from a doc after you have resolved the correct file ID/URL.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

tools.name: zoomdocs_create_doc
tools.description: Create a brand new Zoom Doc. Never use this to modify an existing doc.

markdown.description: Markdown content to import into the new Zoom Doc.

title.description: New doc title. Defaults to Untitled.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID or URL. Defaults to my-docs.

tools.name: zoomdocs_edit_doc
tools.description: Modify an existing Zoom Doc in place and preserve the same fileId/URL when the requested change is supported. Use this for typos, sentence rewrites, paragraph updates, heading text edits, inserting simple blocks after a target, and replacing safe sections under a heading. If the target is missing or ambiguous, this tool returns a structured failure instead of guessing. Use this before creating a replacement copy.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

value.description: Exact visible block text to edit. No fuzzy matching is applied.

within_heading.description: Optional exact heading text used only to disambiguate repeated visible text.

value.description: Exact visible heading text to edit.
Editable ref returned by zoomdocs_get_edit_outline, for example h2:plan/p1.

target.description: High-level locator. Prefer ref from zoomdocs_get_edit_outline when exact text is hard to target. Do not pass block IDs.

text.description: New plain text for the matched block.
Plain text to append to the matched block.

markdown.description: Safe structural markdown to insert after the matched block. Supports flat headings, paragraphs, bullets, and todo items.
Safe structural markdown to replace the content under a matched heading. Supports flat headings, paragraphs, bullets, and todo items.

old_text.description: Exact substring to replace inside the matched block. Must occur exactly once.

dry_run.description: Preview the edit and return before/after without applying any changes. Defaults to false.

tools.name: zoomdocs_edit_doc_batch
tools.description: Apply multiple safe in-place edits to one existing Zoom Doc. The server validates every edit before mutating; if validation fails or two edits target the same block, no changes are applied. Use dry_run first to preview all before/after values, then rerun without dry_run to apply.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.

value.description: Exact visible block text to edit. No fuzzy matching is applied.

within_heading.description: Optional exact heading text used only to disambiguate repeated visible text.

value.description: Exact visible heading text to edit.
Editable ref returned by zoomdocs_get_edit_outline, for example h2:plan/p1.

target.description: High-level locator. Prefer ref from zoomdocs_get_edit_outline when exact text is hard to target. Do not pass block IDs.

text.description: New plain text for the matched block.
Plain text to append to the matched block.

markdown.description: Safe structural markdown to insert after the matched block. Supports flat headings, paragraphs, bullets, and todo items.
Safe structural markdown to replace the content under a matched heading. Supports flat headings, paragraphs, bullets, and todo items.

old_text.description: Exact substring to replace inside the matched block. Must occur exactly once.

edits.description: Ordered edits to validate and apply. Each mutating edit must target a different block.

dry_run.description: Preview all edits and return before/after without applying any changes. Defaults to false.

tools.name: zoomdocs_create_replacement_copy
tools.description: Create a new replacement copy of an existing doc. This produces a new fileId and preserves the original. Use only when the user explicitly wants a copy/new doc or when in-place editing is not possible.

target_file_id.description: Existing Zoom Doc ID or URL to copy from. The new file is created as a sibling.

markdown.description: Markdown content for the new replacement copy.

title.description: Replacement copy title. Defaults to the target doc title.

tools.name: zoomdocs_delete
tools.description: Move a Zoom Doc (or folder) to the trash. Invoke when the user asks to delete, trash, or remove a specific Zoom Docs file. The file is moved to trash, not hard-deleted, so it can typically be restored from the Zoom Docs UI.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL to trash.

tools.name: zoomdocs_move
tools.description: Move a Zoom Doc (or folder) under a different parent folder. Invoke when the user asks to move, relocate, or reorganize a file into another folder.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL to move.

parent_id.description: Destination parent folder ID or URL. Use "my-docs" for the root of the user's personal space.

tools.name: zoomdocs_rename
tools.description: Rename an existing Zoom Docs file after you have resolved the right file ID or URL.

file_id.description: Zoom Docs file ID or URL.
